Kaufmännischer Allrounder : Von der Abrechnung bis zur Kostenkontrolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für wirtschaftliche Aufgaben. Technisches Grundverständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Aufgaben schnell zu durchblicken. Kaufmännisches Wissen und Routine im Umgang mit Abrechnungen. Sicherer Umgang mit Ticketsystemen und Office-Anwendungen. Belastbarkeit, Lösungsorientierung und eine gute Portion Teamgeist. Benefits Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten (nach der Probezeit und in gemeinsamer Absprache im Team) – inklusive Firmennotebook Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit Top-IT-Ausstattung. Ein familiäres Unternehmensklima mit flachen Hierarchien – Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht! Sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen. Regelmäßige Schulungen, Weiterbildungen und Austauschmöglichkeiten mit Experten anderer Standorte. Kostenlose Getränke (Kaffee, Tee, Wasser) und regelmäßige Team-Events. Zugang zum Fitnessprogramm WELLPASS . Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche, falls du umziehen möchtest. Das IT-Systemhaus NEXPERTO aus Kempten hat sich auf die gehobenen Ansprüche mittelständischer Unternehmen spezialisiert. Das Team von NEXPERTO übernimmt sowohl einzelne Projekte als auch die Rolle einer externen IT-Abteilung. Mit Full-Managed-Services halten die IT-Spezialisten rund um die beiden Geschäftsführer Dominik Tauscher und Ilja Moeller die IT-Infrastruktur ihrer Kunden immer aktuell und behalten sie über ein 24/7-Echtzeit-Monitoring ständig im Blick. Zu den Kernkompetenzen von NEXPERTO gehören neben IT-Outsourcing und Managed Services auch Home-Office-Konzepte, Backup-Konzepte und IT-Sicherheitskonzepte. Die tägliche Arbeit von NEXPERTO richtet sich grundsätzlich am eigenen Anspruch aus: Hier will man den Kunden IT-Service der Extraklasse bieten. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: ERP & Cloud Spezialist
description: ERP & Cloud Spezialist (m/w/d) Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central · Dynamics NAV / Navision · Microsoft Cloud AJAT GmbH | Standort Köln Du kennst dich mit Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Navision aus, bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit Business Central mit und bewegst dich sicher im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld? Du verstehst betriebliche Abläufe, gehst technischen Problemen auf den Grund und kannst Anwendern Lösungen verständlich erklären? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Die AJAT GmbH unterstützt Unternehmen in den Bereichen IT-Service, Cloud und Cybersecurity. Für die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von ERP-Umgebungen suchen wir einen ERP-Spezialisten, der fachliches Prozessverständnis mit technischem Wissen verbindet. Deine Aufgaben ERP-Systeme betreuen: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden beim Betrieb und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central und Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Navision – einschließlich älterer NAV-Versionen. Störungen analysieren und lösen: Du nimmst Supportanfragen auf, reproduzierst Fehler, prüfst mögliche Ursachen und dokumentierst die Bearbeitung nachvollziehbar. Dabei unterscheidest du zwischen Bedienungsfragen, Berechtigungsproblemen, Konfigurationsfehlern und technischen Störungen. Geschäftsprozesse verstehen: Du unterstützt Anwender bei Abläufen wie Auftragsbearbeitung, Einkauf, Verkauf, Lagerverwaltung und Rechnungsstellung. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Belegen, Beständen und Buchungen. Benutzer und Berechtigungen verwalten: Du betreust Benutzerzugänge, Rollen und Berechtigungen nach abgestimmten Freigaben und unterstützt bei Zugriffsproblemen. Schnittstellen prüfen: Du analysierst Probleme beim Datenaustausch mit angebundenen Systemen, beispielsweise Lagerverwaltungssystemen oder Microsoft-Diensten, und koordinierst die weitere Bearbeitung mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. Microsoft-Cloud-Anbindungen betreuen: Du unterstützt bei Benutzerverwaltung, Authentifizierung und der Integration von ERP-Systemen in Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID. Änderungen begleiten: Du wirkst an Updates, Tests, Prozessverbesserungen und Migrationsvorhaben mit und stimmst Anforderungen mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungspartnern ab. Wissen weitergeben: Du erstellst verständliche Dokumentationen und unterstützt Anwender dabei, ihre Systeme sicher und effizient zu nutzen. Das bringst du mit Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Navision. Kenntnisse älterer NAV-Versionen, beispielsweise NAV 2016, sind für uns besonders wichtig. Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ist ausdrücklich erwünscht , insbesondere in Betreuung, Konfiguration, Administration oder Beratung. Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld , insbesondere Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID, mit Bezug zu Benutzerverwaltung, Berechtigungen, Authentifizierung und Anwendungsintegration. Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche ERP-Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen technisch einzuordnen. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Probleme bis zur Lösung nachzuverfolgen. Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikation mit Kunden und Kollegen. Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Du kannst technische Sachverhalte erklären, Kundengespräche führen und aussagekräftige Dokumentationen erstellen. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Köln sowie zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen zu unseren Kunden . Zusätzliche Kenntnisse, die uns freuen Erfahrung mit Upgrades oder Migrationen von Dynamics NAV zu Business Central. Kenntnisse in AL für Business Central oder C/AL für ältere NAV-Umgebungen . Erfahrung mit SQL Server und der Analyse lokaler NAV-/ERP-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in PowerShell, Power Automate oder Power BI. Erfahrung mit ERP-Schnittstellen, Webservices und APIs. Was dich bei uns erwartet Eine Aufgabe mit direktem Kundenkontakt, technischen Fragestellungen und Einblicken in unterschiedliche Geschäftsprozesse. Du arbeitest mit unserem IT-Team zusammen und bringst dein Wissen in die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Kundenumgebungen ein. Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Übersicht deiner relevanten Projekterfahrung. Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung konkret an: Mit welchen Business-Central- und NAV-/Navision-Versionen du gearbeitet hast und welche Aufgaben du dabei übernommen hast. Welche Microsoft-Cloud-Dienste du praktisch betreut oder administriert hast. Dein Deutschniveau , deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung . Ob du vor Ort in Köln arbeiten kannst und zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen bereit bist. AJAT GmbH · Köln www.ajat.io Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.</p> <p><strong>Pure delivery manager.<br></strong>You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Day To Day</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.</li> <li>Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.</li> <li>Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.</li> <li>Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.</li> <li>Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.</li> <li>Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.</li> <li>Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.</li> <li>Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Stakeholders</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Director of Engineering:</strong> Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.<br><strong>Direct Reports: </strong>Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth<br><strong>Product Manager:</strong> PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)<br><strong>CTO and CPO: </strong>We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. title: JUNIOR MARKETING & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER (m/w/d)
description: DU LIEBST MARKETING? WIR LIEBEN ES, MENSCHEN ZU BEWEGEN. Dann lass uns gemeinsam etwas bewegen! Stell dir vor, deine Ideen und deine Kreativität tragen dazu bei, dass Menschen weniger Schmerzen haben, nach Verletzungen oder Operationen wieder aktiv werden und Sportler ihre Leistungsfähigkeit zurückgewinnen. Oder dass Menschen bereits heute etwas für ihre Gesundheit tun, um morgen möglichst lange fit, beweglich und voller Lebensfreude zu bleiben. Genau dafür steht K-Active. Und vielleicht bald auch du! WER WIR SIND K-Active ist weit mehr als ein Unternehmen für Therapie-, Medizin- und Sportprodukte. Seit über 25 Jahren begleiten wir Therapeuten, Ärzte, Trainer, Sportler und gesundheitsbewusste Menschen – vom Freizeitsportler bis zum Olympiateilnehmer. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Therapie, Rehabilitation, Regeneration, Diagnostik, Prävention und Longevity. Was uns antreibt? Menschen zu helfen, ihre Gesundheit, Beweglichkeit und Lebensqualität zu verbessern – und ihre persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen. Dafür stehen wir mit innovativen Produkten, neuen Ideen, internationaler Erfahrung und einem Team, das mit Herz und Begeisterung zusammenarbeitet. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur Beiträge postet. Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf, der unsere Begeisterung nach außen trägt. Du erkennst spannende Geschichten, entwickelst Ideen und machst aus unseren Produkten, Partnerschaften und Projekten Inhalte, die Menschen wirklich erreichen. Das kannst du bei uns bewegen: Du entwickelst kreative Social-Media-Inhalte für Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und weitere Kanäle. Du erstellst Fotos, Videos, Reels und Kampagnen, die begeistern und echten Mehrwert bieten. Du begleitest unsere Sportpartner, Therapeuten, Veranstaltungen und Produktneuheiten. Du gestaltest Marketingaktionen, Newsletter und Inhalte für unsere Onlineshops mit. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, erkennst Trends und entwickelst unsere Kommunikation weiter. Du analysierst den Erfolg unserer Maßnahmen und hilfst, unsere Reichweite und Markenbekanntheit auszubauen. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Wir suchen vor allem Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und Begeisterung. Du hast Erfahrung oder eine passende Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Social Media oder Kommunikation, ein gutes Gespür für Bilder, Sprache und Menschen und Freude daran, kreative Inhalte selbst umzusetzen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, denkst mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Idealerweise begeisterst du dich auch für Sport, Gesundheit und Bewegung. Du musst nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du etwas bewegen möchtest! DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI K-ACTIVE Ein Job mit Sinn. Deine Arbeit hilft dabei, innovative Lösungen für Gesundheit, Therapie und Bewegung bekannter zu machen. Ein Team mit Herz und positivem Spirit. Wir arbeiten miteinander, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und freuen uns über Menschen, die mitdenken und mitgestalten. Freiraum für deine Kreativität. Sprachen: sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Calisthenics Bezug: Ein Bezug zur Calisthenics-Szene ist von Vorteil. Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen. Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln. Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben. Kaffee- & Wasser-Flat: Genieße erstklassigen Kaffee aus unserer hochwertigen Kaffeemaschine und stets frisches Wasser aus unserer Wasserfilteranlage. Exklusive Rabatte: Profitiere von Mitarbeiterrabatten auf unsere Equipments und Kleidung für dein Training. Persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Office: Wir setzen auf echte Begegnungen im Büro in Münster statt endloser Online-Calls. Unser Ziel: Ein Office, in dem man sich wohlfühlt und in das man gerne kommt Hundefreundlicher Arbeitsplatz: Nach Absprache kannst du deinen Hund mit ins Büro nehmen. E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus: Du kannst dein E-Auto bequem direkt am Office laden. raw.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
raw.description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

  • Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

  • Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

  • Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

  • Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

  • Test and iterate with our Boston biology team

  • Contribute to grant applications

What you need to succeed

Must-have:

  • MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field

  • Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype

  • CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration

  • Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next

  • Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week

  • Fluent English; German a plus

Nice-to-have:

  • Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics

  • Gas handling or air sampling

  • Startup or grant-funded R&D experience

Why join Cellsor now

Cellsor is an early-stage, VC-backed deep-tech startup, funded to focus on building. Most hardware roles mean optimizing one part of an existing product. Here you build the first instrument for a new category of sensor, and your design decisions become the foundation of the platform. The technical risk has moved from "does this work?" to "how do we build it for the field?" – which is exactly where an engineer makes the difference. As the platform grows into electrode integration, machine learning and product design, so does the scope of your role.

What we offer

  • Equity in Cellsor, so you share in the value you help create

  • The opportunity to build and lead the Munich engineering team as we grow

  • Real responsibility from day one, working directly with the founders and technical advisors

  • Lab and workspace at UnternehmerTUM, with regular exchange with our Boston team

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product. Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors. Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment. Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend. Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation. Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars. Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management. European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models. Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private. The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well. Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq. Frontend: Next.js , React and TypeScript. Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools. You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires. About You You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually. We are looking for: Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped. Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus. Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code. Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure. Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out. A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus. A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up. raw.title: Technical Co-Founder (AI Efficiency) @ AI Venture, Berlin
raw.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the results against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the best combination for each task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks and already have people waiting to use the product. We're now looking for a technical co-founder to help turn this opportunity into a company.

About the Role

As Technical Co-Founder, you will lead the development of our AI efficiency engine, working alongside the founder to turn a compelling technical opportunity into a product.

At the heart of the role is a deceptively simple question: how can we make AI models deliver the same or better results at a fraction of the cost?

You will explore approaches to model routing, fine-tuning, caching and inference optimisation, combining scientific curiosity with the ability to turn promising ideas into measurable improvements.

This is a role for someone who enjoys difficult technical problems, rigorous experimentation and challenging existing approaches. You won't be expected to build every part of the platform yourself. Working alongside our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, you will set the technical direction and focus your expertise where it creates the greatest impact.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. We're looking for someone who already operates this way, using coding agents and developing the workflows and harnesses that allow a small team to move exceptionally quickly without compromising technical quality.

Above all, this is a co-founder role. We're looking for someone who wants to take genuine ownership, work with relentless intensity and help build a company from its earliest stages.

What You'll Work On

  • Drive AI cost efficiency: develop approaches to reducing inference costs through model selection, routing, caching, fine-tuning, quantization and other optimisation techniques.

  • Experiment and benchmark: design rigorous evaluations to understand the trade-offs between cost, quality and latency, turning technical insights into measurable improvements.

  • Shape the efficiency engine: determine how closed and open-weight models can be combined and optimised to deliver the best outcomes for different tasks.

  • Set technical direction: identify promising opportunities, make key architectural decisions and guide the founding engineers in bringing them to production.

  • Push agentic engineering forward: use coding agents as a core part of your work and develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to operate with exceptional leverage.

  • Build the company: work closely with the founder on technical strategy, attract exceptional talent and help shape the product and business.

About You

You bring deep technical curiosity, scientific rigour and an entrepreneurial mindset. You enjoy getting into the details, testing hypotheses and finding approaches others might overlook.

We're particularly interested in people who bring:

  • Deep expertise in AI efficiency: meaningful experience optimising the cost or performance of LLMs or other AI systems, with concrete results to show for it. Experience in inference optimisation, routing, fine-tuning or related techniques is particularly relevant.

  • Strong technical foundations: a solid understanding of modern AI models, rigorous experimentation and the ability to translate research into practical improvements.

  • An agentic approach to engineering: you actively use coding agents, know how to orchestrate them effectively and are excited by what small, highly leveraged teams can achieve.

  • A co-founder mindset: you're resourceful, ambitious and comfortable with uncertainty. You take initiative, move quickly and want to build something from the ground up.

  • Technical leadership potential: you have the judgement to make difficult technical decisions and guide others. Previous CTO or engineering management experience is not required.

We're more interested in exceptional depth in AI efficiency and the ambition to build a company than a conventional CTO background.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with open-weight models, GPU inference or model serving.

  • A strong research or open-source track record in AI or machine learning.

  • Experience taking AI systems into production or working in an early-stage startup.

Why Join

With the pre-seed round closed and early momentum behind us, you'll join at a point where there is considerable room to shape what comes next. You'll work alongside the founder, set the technical direction and receive meaningful co-founder equity in the company you help create.

We're competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that exceptional technical depth, focused decisions and an agentic approach to engineering can give a small team a meaningful advantage.

For someone who wants to apply their expertise in AI efficiency to an ambitious technical challenge, and take the leap from specialist to co-founder, this is an opportunity to build something of their own.

This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

raw.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join bunch’s Reporting team. You’ll own the products and workflows that turn fund and portfolio data into correct, trusted reporting that’s ready to send to investors.

You’ll work at the heart of how fund managers communicate performance and activity to their investors. That means building intuitive reporting experiences and report-generation capabilities customers can trust.

As Senior Product Manager, Reporting Platform, you will:

  • Own key parts of our reporting product and its workflows end-to-end

  • Make sure the numbers investors see are right, from the data fund managers enter, through the calculations, to the final reports and the LP portal

  • Drive product decisions that balance accuracy, compliance and usability

  • Partner closely with engineering, design and operations to deliver a system customers can rely on

This role focuses on the Reporting side of the platform. Typical areas include:

  • Portfolio data capture: how fund managers record investments, valuations and portfolio events like follow-ons, conversions and exits, with a strong focus on intuitive UI/UX, data quality and completeness

  • The calculation layer between fund accounting and investor reporting: turning the fund’s books and portfolio valuations into correct investor numbers, with checks that tie them together

  • Report generation workflows: quarterly and annual packages, capital account statements and PDFs ready to send to investors

  • Configuration and customisation: templates, branding, disclosures, and language and currency formatting

  • Data readiness and correctness for reports: validation, completeness checks and auditability

  • Distribution and delivery: review and approval flows, delivery to investors, and access controls

  • Observability for reporting runs: errors, retries, performance and transparency for customers

Top Responsibilities

  • Drive roadmap and execution for reporting workflows and the reporting experiences customers see

  • Translate domain requirements into clear product specs (inputs → transformations → outputs) with strong edge-case handling

  • Partner with engineering to define the right building blocks for scalable report generation (templates, data contracts, versioning)

  • Collaborate with design to make complex reporting setup and review flows intuitive and fast

  • Work with fund accounting, operations and customer-facing teams to identify friction, ensure correctness and improve time-to-report

  • Define and track success metrics across adoption, report quality, operational efficiency and reliability

  • Maintain a high bar for data integrity, traceability and customer trust

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience building B2B fintech products

  • Strong product execution skills: shipping, iteration loops, prioritization and stakeholder alignment

  • A solid grasp of financial reporting basics: how they work and why every number has to trace back to a source. Experience from accounting, banking, payments, treasury or financial data products all counts

  • Ability to turn complex requirements into simple product surfaces and crisp product logic

  • Analytical mindset: you can define metrics, investigate root causes and make data-informed tradeoffs

  • Excellent communication: you write clear specs and collaborate well with technical and non-technical partners

  • Experience working closely with engineering on systems that need reliability, monitoring and rigor on edge cases

  • Nice to have: exposure to fund or investment reporting (NAV, capital accounts, fees, IRR, TVPI, DPI). You don’t need a private markets background. We’ll teach you, and you’ll work every day with our fund accounting experts

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup with 2 days a week in the office

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 140+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (20 min) to get to know bunch and explore whether what we’re offering matches what you’re looking for

  • Hiring manager interview with our VP of Product (45 min) to discuss your experience, your approach and your fit for the role

  • Product case interview with our Product & Design team (60 min) to show your product thinking, communication and execution style

  • Stakeholder interviews (3 x 30 min) with members of Operations, Engineering and our Founders to align on vision and expectations

Curious to learn more?

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p>&nbsp;This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as ambassador for the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Candidates will have relevant experience and/or qualifications in the field of fire raw.title: Enterprise  Account Director
raw.description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

Bandwidth is looking for an Account Director to own new business revenue within the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem. This is an individual contributor, new logo role - built for a commercially aggressive hunter who thrives on closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

At its core, this role exists because of a strategic partnership. Bandwidth is the first Preferred and Certified Carrier for Salesforce Native Contact Center internationally, so Salesforce enterprise AEs direct customers with BYOC telephony requirements to Bandwidth. The Account Director will own that inbound pipeline and convert it, while simultaneously self-sourcing additional new business.

This role also involves working alongside channel partners in B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's carrier capability is required to complete the solution. This is a collaboration motion, not a channel management role - the AD works with partners to close specific deals, not to recruit or develop the partner base.

The right candidate brings 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, credibility within the Salesforce or CCaaS ecosystem, and the commercial instinct to operate across a dual motion: partner-referred inbound and self-sourced outbound. You should be as comfortable working alongside a Salesforce AE on a joint pursuit as you are prospecting independently into a target account.

What You'll Do:

New Business Pipeline & Conversion

  • Own the full new business sales cycle for Salesforce Native Contact Center BYOC opportunities — from initial qualification through commercial structuring, negotiation, and contractual close
  • Manage and convert inbound pipeline referred by Salesforce AEs, maintaining deal velocity and ensuring Bandwidth is positioned correctly at each stage of the customer's evaluation process
  • Self-source additional new logo pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts operating within or adjacent to the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem
  • Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with strong CRM hygiene; manage forecasting and deal progression with the discipline expected at Account Director level of commercial engagement
  • Execute against individual revenue targets spanning both Salesforce-referred and directly sourced new business

Salesforce Partnership Collaboration

  • Build trusted, day-to-day working relationships with Salesforce enterprise AEs and their management - becoming the go-to Bandwidth contact for BYOC opportunities within their accounts
  • Participate in joint account planning with Salesforce sellers, helping map enterprise accounts with BYOC requirements and aligning on pursuit strategy
  • Engage Salesforce alliance and partnership contacts as needed to maintain commercial alignment and ensure inbound lead quality improves over time
  • Represent Bandwidth credibly in joint customer meetings alongside Salesforce - operating as a senior commercial peer, not a subcontractor

Channel Partner Collaboration on Enterprise Deals

  • Work alongside channel partners - including MSPs, SIs and Salesforce implementation partners - on B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's BYOC carrier capability is part of the solution they are delivering
  • Support channel-led pursuits by providing Bandwidth's commercial, technical and contractual expertise at the appropriate point in the deal cycle
  • Ensure deal economics are structured correctly in partner-involved transactions, with clear accountability for Bandwidth's revenue and obligations
  • Maintain strong working relationships with key channel partner contacts on active deals, providing the senior Bandwidth commercial presence they need to close

Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across CIO, CTO, VP of CX, operations and procurement - positioning Bandwidth as a strategic infrastructure partner for their Salesforce Contact Center deployment
  • Lead commercial negotiations on high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements, working across legal, security, finance and procurement to reach close
  • Orchestrate internal Bandwidth resources - Solutions Engineering, Legal, Product, Finance and Operations - around complex deals without losing deal momentum
  • Operate comfortably across large enterprise and complex mid-market deal sizes, adjusting commercial approach and engagement model appropriately

Market Intelligence & Commercial Feedback

  • Maintain a strong and current understanding of the Salesforce Native Contact Center landscape - how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt it, where BYOC fits into the decision, and what objections Bandwidth regularly faces
  • Provide commercial and competitive insight back to Bandwidth's product and GTM teams - surfacing patterns from the Salesforce channel and direct deals that should inform positioning and product direction
  • Stay informed on competitive dynamics across BYOC, CPaaS and CCaaS so you can position Bandwidth accurately and confidently in contested opportunities

What You Need:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience - with a consistent, verifiable track record of closing six- and seven-figure ARR new logo deals in competitive, technically complex markets

  • Demonstrable experience operating in or alongside the Salesforce ecosystem - whether through co-sell motions with Salesforce AEs, selling into Salesforce-driven transformation programmes, or selling solutions that integrate with or complement Salesforce Contact Center or Service Cloud

    • Ability to build relationships at C-suite and VP level across IT, operations, procurement and CX functions, with the executive presence to represent Bandwidth as a senior commercial peer
    • Commercial acumen and deal-structuring capability to lead complex multi-stakeholder negotiations, including multi-party agreements involving channel partners
    • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline — comfortable managing a multi-source revenue target across Salesforce-referred inbound and self-sourced pipeline with full visibility and accuracy
    • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals: SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, international connectivity and regulatory considerations including E911
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience
    • Strong understanding of BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) commercial and technical models - including how BYOC works within CCaaS and CRM platforms and what enterprise buyers need to understand to move forward

  • Experience working alongside channel partners on enterprise deals - understanding how to contribute to a partner-led pursuit, structure Bandwidth's commercial involvement and close without creating friction in the partner relationship

  • Solid knowledge of the CPaaS, CCaaS and cloud communications landscape - including the competitive dynamics, key platform players and how enterprises evaluate and adopt carrier-level infrastructure

Bonus Points:

  •  Existing working relationships within the Salesforce enterprise sales organisation — AEs, RVPs or alliance leadership — that can generate immediate inbound opportunity flow

  • Direct experience selling BYOC solutions within or alongside a CCaaS or CRM platform — including Genesys, Five9, NICE, Talkdesk or equivalent environments

  • Familiarity with Natterbox, Aircall, Dialpad or other Salesforce-native voice providers — and a clear understanding of how Bandwidth differentiates as a carrier in that space
  • Experience selling into regulated enterprise environments where compliance, resilience and security are key components of the buying decision
  • Prior exposure to Bandwidth's product portfolio or existing relationships with Bandwidth's channel or implementation partners
  • Experience working within structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Value Selling or similar frameworks

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Work laptop & mobile phone with a competitive subscription plan, and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home.
  • We contribute 8% of your monthly gross salary into your private pension.
  • Income protection plan to ensure you'll receive a regular income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
  • Life insurance providing financial support to your loved ones in the event of your unexpected passing.
  • Health insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process, and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
  • Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
  • Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
  • Childcare support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years.
  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes. Role Description This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows. The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank. Principal Accountabilities Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions. Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment. Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules. Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models. Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists. Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic. Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment. Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review. Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment. Personal Attributes & Experience You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems. You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools. You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity. You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending. You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank. You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment. You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team. You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders. Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable. Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Make in-day adjustments to staffing. Manage contingency planning for demand spikes and extreme weather. Review and validate forecasts produced by the offshore team (short-term, long-term, and budget forecasts). Ensure forecasting assumptions align with business drivers, marketing plans, seasonality, and growth projections. Drive continuous improvement. Align offshore staffing models with UK demand forecasts. Escalate performance issues. Challenge assumptions and drive continuous improvement in forecasting methodologies. Communicate with local JBC Management teams to maintain accuracy. Work with Head of / JBC Director on medium & long term budgets and headcount modelling. Identify risks to over/under staffings. raw.description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The role

Our in-house engineering team builds and runs every product we operate. We work in two product teams, iGaming and Rewards, supported by platform and infrastructure engineers. We are partway through building a new version of our platform, which makes this the right moment to put quality engineering at the heart of how we deliver.

You will lead quality engineering across both product teams. You will guide how we test, build the frameworks and pipelines that make testing fast, and help every engineer take ownership of the quality of their own work.

This is a hands-on technical role. Early on you will write a lot of the framework code yourself. Over time your influence will come through the tooling you build and the engineers you coach.

What you'll do

  • Define our test strategy: what we test at unit, integration, contract and end-to-end level, so every team knows where a given test belongs and why.

  • Build and own our automation framework in Playwright and TypeScript, covering web front ends and APIs across both product teams.

  • Make CI feedback fast and trustworthy.

  • Bring our existing end-to-end suite to a healthy state and keep it there as the new platform grows.

  • Coach developers to write and own tests for their own code, through pairing, code review and clear examples.

  • Set up test data and environments that let teams test realistically and safely.

  • Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications.

  • Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate.

  • Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next.

About you

  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with test code written to the same standard as production code.

  • Deep experience with a modern browser automation framework. Playwright is ideal; Cypress experience transfers well (we’re in the process of migrating from Cypress to Playwright).

  • A track record of designing test strategy across the full testing pyramid for web products and APIs, including judging where automation earns its keep.

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions ideally) with Docker, and fixing pipelines that are slow or unreliable.

  • Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice.

Nice to have

  • Contract testing in a service-based architecture, for example with Pact.

  • Performance and load testing with k6, Artillery or similar.

  • Using AI coding assistants to speed up writing and maintaining tests, with the judgement to review what they produce.

  • Using observability data and production signals to decide what to test.

  • Visual regression or accessibility testing.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

How you work

  • You explain quality trade-offs to product managers and business stakeholders in plain terms.

  • You will hold a release back when the evidence says it is not ready, and then help the team find a safe way to ship.

  • You write things down: strategies, decisions and guides other engineers can pick up and follow.

  • You are comfortable shaping a practice from an early stage, where you will need to decide what matters most first.

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

raw.title: Employee Relations Lead
raw.description:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role

This is a senior specialist role within our People & Business Operations team. You will be the organisation's expert on employee relations, providing guidance and directly managing complex people matters, maintaining effective working relationships with union representatives, including regular engagement and the resolution of collective issues, supporting business change and ensuring our people frameworks remain effective, practical and legally compliant.

Alongside complex casework, you will take ownership of key people frameworks, ensuring decisions relating to progression, promotion and employee relations are applied consistently and fairly.

This role offers the opportunity to shape how Legal 500 approaches employee relations, people governance and organisational frameworks over the coming years.

What you'll do

Employee Relations & Advice

  • Lead on complex employee relations matters, providing expert advice and guidance to managers and senior stakeholders

  • Support the management of investigations, disciplinary, grievance, performance, capability and absence cases where senior specialist input is required

  • Monitor emerging employment law developments and ensure organisational policies and processes remain compliant

People Frameworks & Governance

  • Maintain and continuously improve frameworks that support consistent people decision-making across the organisation

  • Oversee job description governance, ensuring role profiles remain accurate, consistent and aligned to agreed standards

  • Support fair and transparent approaches to promotion, progression and pay review activity

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced Employee Relations professional who combines strong technical expertise with excellent judgement and stakeholder management skills.

You'll likely bring:

  • Significant employee relations experience gained within a medium-sized or large organisation

  • Experience managing complex and sensitive employee relations matters

  • Strong working knowledge of UK employment law

  • Experience advising senior leaders and influencing decision-making

  • Experience leading or supporting formal collective consultation processes and building constructive relationships with employee representatives in a unionised or representative environment

  • Able to balance legal compliance, commercial priorities and employee engagement when handling complex organisational change

  • Excellent communication, influencing and relationship-building skills

  • A pragmatic, solutions-focused approach balanced with sound judgement and attention to risk

  • Experience developing, implementing or maintaining people frameworks such as grading, levelling, progression or reward structures would be advantageous

  • Experience working within professional services, publishing, media or similar environments would be beneficial

What Success Looks Like

  • Managers are confident and well supported when handling employee relations matters

  • Complex cases are managed effectively and consistently

  • People frameworks are trusted, maintained and applied fairly

  • Policies and processes remain compliant and fit for purpose

  • Strong, constructive relationships are maintained across key stakeholder groups, including union representatives and union regional officers

  • Employee relations risk is identified and addressed proactively

Role Information

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

title: Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections RH
description: Notre entreprise Depuis 2007, Kercia est pionnier dans les technologies de vote électronique pour les élections professionnelles. Basée à Grenoble et Paris, notre équipe de 63 personnes accompagne plus de 5 000 organisations —PME, ETI et Grands Groupes — pour simplifier, sécuriser et réenchanter leurs processus électoraux. Kercia met à disposition une plateforme qui permet de gérer tous types d’élections avec des services adaptés à chaque organisation. Notre ambition : devenir le n°1 du vote électronique en France. KERCIA appuie sa stratégie de croissance sur le développement d’un environnement qui permet à tous « Les KERCIENS » de bénéficier d’une expérience salarié positive, individuellement et collectivement. Nous recherchons Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections désireux de s’investir dans la réussite des objectifs de notre entreprise. En rejoignant la communauté des KERCIENS, tu participes à l’aventure d’une entreprise à taille humaine, qui saura t’accueillir avec bienveillance pour ce poste au sein du service opérationnel. Ton poste et tes missions Rattaché(e) au Manager opérationnel, tu assureras la réalisation de projets de vote électronique pour les clients en garantissant la tenue des délais, le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires et en optimisant la satisfaction du client. Tu seras basé(e) à Meylan, aux pieds des montagnes dans un bâtiment neuf au 5ième et dernier étage. Ce sont des espaces lumineux et modernes, avec une vuepanoramique à 360° sur les montagnes. Pour te repérer : https://share.google/8RQ9qsOwmtwZ1evCw Tu auras 3 jours/semaine possible de télétravail. Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe de Chef(fe)s de projets, experte dans son domaine et passionnée par sa mission. Tes missions principales seront : D’assurer la réalisation des projets dans le respect des critères de qualité et dans un objectif de satisfaction client - Organiser les réunions de lancement avec les clients : - Proposer le planning établi en fonction des échéances du vote - Valider les points juridiques clés - Prendre en compte les attentes particulières du client - Réaliser le paramétrage de l’outil de vote électronique en s’assurant de la validation par le client - Piloter la réunion de scellement des urnes - Superviser le déroulement des élections et intervenir en support de 2eme niveau en cas de sollicitation - Animer la réunion de dépouillement des élections en rassurant sur la fiabilité du vote électronique - Réaliser un bilan du projet et envoyer un questionnaire de satisfaction au client - Organiser un point de débriefing avec le client pour les dossiers stratégiques De garantir le respect des obligations juridiques ou règlementaires particulières au projet - Recueillir auprès du client tous les documents d’entrée permettant d’évaluer les contraintes juridiques du client - Rédiger et fournir au client les notes/fiches juridiques nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet - Mettre en application les besoins juridiques du client (ex : échéances, sièges, quorum…) - Conseiller sur leur adaptation aux spécificités du projet et attentes du client - S’assurer de la prise en compte des règles juridiques (légales, conventionnelles) par le client tout au long du processus de vote De contribuer à la sécurité de l’information dans le cadre de tes missions Appliquer l’ensemble des politiques, procédures et bonnes pratiques de KERCIA en matière de sécurité de l’information dans tes activités de gestion de projets et de conseil juridique Veiller à la confidentialité, à l’intégrité et à la disponibilité des informations traitées (données électorales, données clients, documents juridiques, contrats, etc.) Signaler sans délai tout incident, suspicion d’incident ou non-conformité lié à la sécurité de l’information via les canaux internes prévus Participer, le cas échéant, aux actions de sensibilisation et d’amélioration continue en matière de sécurité de l’information (retours d’expérience, contribution à la FAQ interne, mise à jour de supports, etc.) Tu travailleras en synergie avec l’ensemble des services de KERCIA (commercial, technique, administratif, direction, …) et tu participeras à l’ensemble des ateliers et à la vie quotidienne de la communauté Kercienne. Tu génèreras de l’impact et de la satisfaction client au travers de tes missions. À ton intégration, tu suivras un cursus de formation interne aux méthodologies et aux standards de qualité KERCIA. Dès ton arrivée et tout au long de ta prise de poste, tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe. Partie intégrante du service opérationnel, le travail d’équipe et l’entraide sont au cœur des valeurs Kerciennes. Ton profil Tes atouts et toi De formation supérieure bac+2 (BTS / DUT) à bac+3/4 , tu as une forte appétence pour la gestion de projets et le conseil. Tu as acquis une expérience de 2 à 3 ans en Gestion des Ressources Humaines / Gestion de Projets ou Gestion Juridique (alternance incluse). Des connaissances en matière d’Elections Professionnelles seraient un plus et des compétences en matière de Relations Sociales / Gestion du Climat Social / Droit social sont recherchées pour répondre aux attentes du poste Diplomate, tu possèdes un bon relationnel, tu es reconnu(e) pour ton aisance orale et rédactionnelle. Tu es agile et autonome, doté(e) d’une bonne capacité d’organisation et de priorisation. Ton état d’esprit est orienté solutions. Tu sais faire preuve d’empathie et de bienveillance. Ton esprit de camaraderie et tes idées folles sont attendus sur ce poste ! Bonus : ton appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et ta maitrise du PACK OFFICE seraient un plus pour répondre pleinement aux attentes du poste. Mobile, tu seras amené(e) à te déplacer sur l’ensemble du territoire pour le compte de tes clients. Des réunions de coordinations régulières auront également lieu au siège à Meylan (38). Tu souhaites rejoindre une équipe dynamique dans un environnement stimulant ? Déposes ton CV sur ce formulaire (plus bas) ou postule via le bouton sur cette page. Nous t’attendons pour une prise de poste à partir de novembre / décembre 2026. Poste à pourvoir en CDD 12 mois / prime qualité / tickets restaurant / intéressement / séminaire d’entreprise. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. Votre intégration chez Kercia : Dès votre premier jour, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour que vous soyez accueilli dans les meilleures conditions : votre poste de travail (PC, bureau ect.) est prêt et configuré, et un « Pack Welcome » vous attend. Pour faciliter vos débuts, un parrain dédié vous accompagne et des sessions « Vis-ma-Vie » sont organisées pour vous permettre de découvrir nos différents métiers. Chez Kercia, l'onboarding est un véritable parcours de plusieurs semaines conçu pour vous intégrer naturellement à l'équipe et vous accompagner dans vos nouvelles missions au sein d'un environnement attentif à l'épanouissement de chacun. Rémunération et avantages Package salariale pour ce poste comprise entre EUR 25,000 et 34,000 par an (fixe et variable). Vous bénéficiez de 25 jours de congés payés par an. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. AI is a key investment area for Kraken Technologies. A crucial part of this is building the shared foundations that let every team use AI well and move faster on our mission. You'll work in AI Foundations . We build the platform that lets teams across Kraken build and run AI agents. Our work covers four areas: Access: connecting people and systems to approved AI models and tools Context: grounding AI in trusted Kraken knowledge, data and systems Enablement: reusable building blocks for AI-powered workflows and products Governance: permissions, safety, quality, cost and visibility across the lifecycle 🏡 Where you'll fit in We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join one of our three squads: Context: Build the Kraken-specific knowledge layer to make LLMs useful. This covers our internal AI assistant, a structured "client brain" that captures client context and decisions, and pipelines that collect knowledge from tools like Notion, Slack and GitHub. Tooling: deliver LLMs into people's hands. We run the AI Hub (usage insights, MCP gateway, self-serve and specialist agents), the LiteLLM gateway behind Claude Code, Codex and Claude Desktop, and secure cloud dev boxes for AI-assisted engineering. Evals & Observability: covers skill evals, internal benchmarking, agent safety and guardrails, and observability for live AI runs. Squads are flexible: when priorities shift, people move. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. Build and run agents: Work out how agents are triggered, authenticated, monitored and governed across systems like Slack, GitHub, Notion and Asana. Ship both self-serve agents and specialist agents. Ground AI in Kraken context: Collect, structure and serve company knowledge so agents give answers that are correct, current and safe to use. Measure and prove quality: Define meaningful test cases, build evals whose results can be reproduced, and add tracing so we know how AI behaves in real use. Build in safety and governance: Turn permissions, guardrails, budgets and data-access rules into software you can maintain, working with Security and TechOps. Hands-on LLM and agent experience: You have built real things with LLMs, you know where they fail, and you use AI coding tools every day. Cloud experience: You're comfortable running services in AWS and owning their reliability and scalability. Product sense: You care whether people actually use what you build. Clear communication: You can explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical people and challenge ideas constructively. Learning agility: You pick up new tools and domains quickly in a field that changes every month. 🚀 What success looks like Adoption: You ship platform features that teams across Kraken adopt and rely on. Solid systems: The services you own are observable, secure, scalable and cost-aware. Trust at scale: Teams can build and trust agents without rebuilding the basics. Team impact: You make your squad, and the teams around it, better. ⭐️ Bonus points: AI engineering: Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, LangChain, MCP servers Knowledge and retrieval: RAG, search, embeddings, knowledge graphs Evals and safety: Inspect AI, Ragas, OpenAI Evals, NeMo Guardrails, red teaming Platform: Kubernetes, sandboxed or cloud dev environments, AWS Bedrock Backend: Django Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. You will manage a portfolio of Mid-Market and Enterprise customers and cover the entire customer journey, with a strong focus on onboarding, implementation, product adoption and long-term customer success.

You will become a trusted partner and expert on the Dastra platform, helping customers translate complex business, technical and regulatory challenges into concrete use cases.

  • Successfully onboard and implement Dastra

  • Support change management

  • Lead onboarding and implementation projects

  • Monitor usage, satisfaction and value

  • Identify growth opportunities alongside Account Managers

  • Build expertise in data protection, AI governance and compliance

You will join our Customer Success team and report to Jérôme, our Director of Operations and co-founder.

title: Adjoint Responsable de Production / Ingénieur Process Junior (H/F)
description: Au sein de son usine de recyclage de batteries lithium-ion située à Saint-Laurent-Blangy, Battri déploie une ligne industrielle de pointe dédiée au recyclage par broyage, séparation/extraction tmécanique des composants de batteries. Rattaché(e) directement au responsable de production et développement process, tu seras au cœur de l’exploitation et de l’amélioration d’une ligne équipée de technologies industrielles de premier plan. Dans un contexte de montée en cadence et d’optimisation continue de notre outil industriel, nous recherchons un(e) Adjoint Responsable de Production / Ingénieur Process Junior (H/F) , récemment diplômé(e), souhaitant conjuguer rigueur technique , amélioration continue et présence sur le terrain . 🎯 Missions principales Avec l’appui du responsable de production et en collaboration étroite avec les équipes, tu contribueras au pilotage, à l’optimisation et à la fiabilisation de la ligne de procédé. 1. Suivi et optimisation des procédés Pilotage de la performance procédé : analyser quotidiennement le fonctionnement de la ligne, identifier les écarts et contribuer à la définition des actions d’amélioration. Amélioration des rendements : optimiser la pureté et les taux de récupération des fractions valorisables ( Black Mass , cuivre, aluminium et feuilles séparatrices). Essais industriels et industrialisation : préparer, suivre et analyser les campagnes d’essais liées à l’intégration de nouvelles générations de batteries ou de nouveaux flux entrants. Analyse des dérives : diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements procédés — colmatage, dérives granulométriques ou aérauliques — et proposer des plans d’actions correctifs. Exploitation des données : structurer les relevés, analyser les résultats et formaliser des recommandations techniques. 2. Amélioration continue et performance industrielle Déploiement des outils Lean : contribuer à la démarche d’amélioration continue de la ligne à travers les méthodes 5S, SMED, Kaizen et AMDEC Process. Analyse de la performance : suivre et interpréter les principaux indicateurs de la ligne, notamment le TRS, la cadence, les pertes matières et les consommations énergétiques. Standardisation : rédiger, mettre à jour et faire appliquer les instructions de travail et les modes opératoires afin de fiabiliser les pratiques de production. Plans de progrès : participer à la priorisation, au déploiement et au suivi des actions d’amélioration. 3. Support opérationnel et animation terrain Proximité avec les équipes : assurer le relais technique de l’Ingénieur Produit Process auprès des opérateurs et des chefs d’équipe. Rituels de performance : participer aux rituels quotidiens de production et les coanimer afin de faire remonter les aléas et de suivre les actions engagées. Résolution de problèmes : accompagner les équipes dans l’analyse des incidents et la mise en œuvre de solutions durables. Accompagnement du changement : former et sensibiliser les équipes aux nouveaux standards, aux réglages des procédés et aux bonnes pratiques de conduite des installations. 4. Sécurité industrielle et HSE Culture sécurité : veiller au respect strict des consignes HSE dans un environnement classé Seveso Seuil Haut , inscrit dans une démarche conforme aux référentiels ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001. Analyse des risques : contribuer aux études de sécurité des procédés, notamment aux analyses HAZOP, aux analyses d’accidents et de presque-accidents ainsi qu’à la prise en compte des risques ATEX et liés aux poussières. Amélioration des pratiques : identifier les situations à risque et participer à la mise en œuvre des mesures de prévention. Ce que nous t’offrons Un premier poste responsabilisant sur des technologies de pointe, au cœur de la transition énergétique et de la mobilité durable. Une immersion complète au sein d’un site industriel innovant et en forte croissance. Un accompagnement de proximité par un Ingénieur Produit Process expérimenté, favorisant une montée en compétences progressive. Des missions concrètes associant expertise technique, amélioration continue et collaboration avec les équipes de terrain. Une réelle possibilité de contribuer à la montée en puissance et à la performance d’un outil industriel stratégique. 👤 Profil recherché Diplôme d’ingénieur ou formation universitaire de niveau Bac+5 en génie des procédés, génie chimique, génie industriel, matériaux ou domaine équivalent. Première expérience en environnement industriel appréciée, y compris dans le cadre d’un stage, d’une alternance ou d’un projet de fin d’études. Goût prononcé pour le terrain, l’analyse de données et la résolution de problèmes techniques. Connaissance des outils d’amélioration continue et des principaux indicateurs de performance industrielle. Rigueur, curiosité, autonomie et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés. Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité industrielle et environnementale. Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG . L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise. Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend. L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud. La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité. La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes.
