description: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? Vous souhaitez donner du sens aux données et développer des modèles prédictifs qui répondent à des enjeux métiers concrets ? Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée ! Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital . Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering et Intelligence Artificielle . Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation. Nous accompagnons des clients issus de secteurs variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning. Nos missions en Data Science Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient expertise technique, Data Science et compréhension des enjeux business . Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances. L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients. Quelques exemples de projets Data Science Prévision des ventes et du chiffre d’affaires : conception de modèles prédictifs pour anticiper le chiffre d’affaires généré sur le site e-commerce d’un acteur du Retail et améliorer la prise de décision. Systèmes de recommandation : développement et industrialisation d’un moteur de recommandation pour personnaliser l’expérience utilisateur et optimiser la conversion des visiteurs d’un site web. Prédiction de l’attrition client (Churn) : création de modèles de scoring pour identifier les clients présentant un risque de désengagement et permettre aux équipes métiers d’anticiper leurs actions de fidélisation. Segmentation client et ciblage marketing : mise en place de modèles de segmentation pour affiner les stratégies marketing et commerciales, personnaliser les campagnes et adapter les actions de fidélisation aux comportements et aux préférences des clients. Ces projets vous permettront de mobiliser des techniques de Machine Learning, de modélisation prédictive, de scoring et de segmentation client , tout en développant votre expertise sur des cas d’usage concrets à forte valeur ajoutée. Les qualités humaines Chez AVISIA, nous recherchons avant tout des talents curieux, impliqués et désireux de progresser. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes ? Vous avez un excellent relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe comme les échanges avec les clients. Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les projets et contribuer concrètement à la réussite des missions. Vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, avec la capacité de prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus. Vous êtes attentif(ve) à la qualité de vos livrables et savez présenter et vulgariser des résultats complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques. Vous êtes curieux(se), vous vous intéressez aux évolutions de la Data Science et du Machine Learning et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches. Vous avez envie de continuer à apprendre, de développer votre expertise et d’être acteur(trice) de votre progression professionnelle. Vous justifiez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Data Science, Machine Learning ou modélisation statistique. Vos compétences techniques Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure spécialisée en Data Science, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent, à l’université ou en école d’ingénieurs. Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : Vous connaissez les principales techniques de modélisation statistique et de Machine Learning : Random Forest, XGBoost, K-means, etc. Vous maîtrisez le SQL pour extraire, manipuler et analyser les données. Vous pratiquez Python, R et/ou SAS pour réaliser des analyses de données et développer des modèles prédictifs. Vous connaissez au moins une solution de traitement et d’analyse de données du marché, comme Dataiku, SAS ou Alteryx . Des connaissances des environnements Cloud, notamment Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS ou Azure , constituent un plus. Nous attachons autant d’importance à votre capacité à mobiliser vos compétences techniques qu’à votre compréhension des enjeux métiers. L’objectif est de concevoir des modèles pertinents, fiables et exploitables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Une formation continue via l’AVISIA School, pour développer vos compétences et rester à la pointe des technologies Data & IA. Des certifications pour valoriser votre expertise et accompagner votre montée en compétences. De réelles perspectives d’évolution : Contributeur, Senior, Tech Lead, Business Leader, Practice Leader… Plusieurs parcours sont possibles selon vos envies et vos ambitions. Un accompagnement de proximité , avec des échanges réguliers pour suivre vos projets et construire la suite de votre parcours. Le partage et l’intelligence collective , grâce à nos communautés d’experts, nos retours d’expérience et nos initiatives internes. Une culture d’entreprise conviviale et engagée , où l’humain compte autant que l’expertise technique. Le processus de recrutement Nous privilégions un processus de recrutement structuré et transparent, qui vous permet de découvrir AVISIA, de présenter votre parcours et d’échanger sur vos compétences et vos attentes. Un premier échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition : un entretien téléphonique, en visio ou sur site pour discuter de votre parcours, de vos motivations et de votre projet professionnel. Un test technique : un QCM et des cas pratiques vous seront envoyés par mail le soir même de votre entretien RH. Vous disposerez de 7 jours pour les réaliser. Un entretien technique : vous rencontrerez un consultant senior, un manager ou un Practice Leader, idéalement sur site, pour approfondir vos compétences techniques et échanger sur les missions proposées. Des échanges informels avec l’équipe pourront également être organisés si besoin, afin de vous permettre de découvrir votre futur environnement de travail et de poser toutes vos questions. Envie de mettre votre expertise en Data Science au service de projets concrets et de continuer à progresser au sein d’une équipe passionnée ? Rejoignez AVISIA ! Rattaché(e) à Charline, Directrice R&D, en tant que Responsable R&D Charcuterie & Végé, votre rôle sera de piloter ce pôle R&D et d'accompagner les équipes, présentes sur 4 sites de production, afin d'assurer la réalisation de notre pipe innovation sur ces deux univers de produits.

Un poste stratégique, à la croisée de la tradition, de l'innovation et des nouvelles attentes de consommation !

 

🔬 Vos missions au quotidien

  • Manager et accompagner l'équipe R&D Charcuterie & Végé afin de garantir la réalisation de l'ensemble du pipe projets, dans le respect des objectifs de qualité, coûts et délais, et ce dans le cadre de nos processus : Recherche appliquée, Innovation, Développement et Optimisation

  • Piloter les projets stratégiques d'innovation et de recherche appliquée, qu'ils portent sur la charcuterie traditionnelle ou le développement de nouvelles alternatives à base de protéines végétales, en assurant leur bon déroulement et leur reporting auprès de la Direction

  • Suivre, valider et être force de proposition sur les nouveaux produits, ainsi que sur leur évolution et optimisation

  • Structurer et animer une veille active sur les process, les ingrédients, la concurrence, notamment autour des protéines végétales et des nouvelles technologies de transformation, en lien avec les différentes parties prenantes

  • Être garant(e) du respect de notre politique qualité, sécurité, nutritionnelle et RSE sur l'ensemble du périmètre Charcuterie & Végé

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les services support R&D (Recherche, Emballage, Data, microbio…) ainsi qu'avec l'ensemble des équipes Fleury Michon : Marketing, Industriel, PMO, Qualité, Achats...

Dans un souci d’accessibilité et de clarté, l’écriture inclusive n’est pas utilisée dans cette annonce. Les termes employés au masculin se réfèrent aussi bien au genre féminin que masculin.


👤 Votre profil

Titulaire d'un Bac +4/5, vous justifiez d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience, dont 3 à 5 ans en R&D, idéalement dans l'univers de la charcuterie, de la viande ou des alternatives végétales.

À l'aise dans la gestion de projets et le pilotage d'activité, vous avez déjà eu l'occasion d'accompagner et de faire grandir une équipe.

Curieux(se), engagé(e) et force de proposition, vous avez envie de relever un challenge inédit : faire dialoguer l'expertise de la charcuterie avec les opportunités offertes par le végétal, pour imaginer les produits de demain.

 

Vous avez du talent. Nous avons hâte de le voir s'exprimer.

Rejoignez une équipe engagée, bénéficiez d'un accompagnement personnalisé et profitez d'un environnement qui favorise votre développement professionnel et personnel.

 

✨ Parcours d'intégration • Formation • Télétravail ( 2 jours/semaine) • Hub Nantes et La Rochelle • CSE • Magasin d'usine • Intéressement, Participation • Compte Epargne Temps  •

 

Un recrutement simple et rapide

Parce qu'un recrutement réussi commence par des échanges de qualité :

1️⃣ Un premier échange en visioconférence avec un chargé de recrutement pour faire connaissance et répondre à vos questions.

2️⃣ Une rencontre avec votre futur manager et votre interlocuteur RH pour échanger sur le poste, vos motivations et votre projet professionnel.

raw.description:
Your job

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

 

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

  • low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

  • context-switch-free code

  • design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

  • data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

  • complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

  • re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

 

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

 

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.


Who are you

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

  • extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

  • understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

  • knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

  • understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

  • ability to work with debuggers and profilers

  • operative coding (git, documentation)

  • ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

  • pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

  • experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases

  • Fun and inspiring work environment

  • Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Switzerland to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  • Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for consumer and retail brands.

  • Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swiss consumer and retail organizations operating at scale.

  • Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  • Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swiss consumer and retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  • Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  • Well-connected in the Swiss consumer and retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Switzerland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  • A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  • Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration.

Location

This is an in-country role based in Zurich.

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
description: L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur. Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire. Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F . Votre mission : Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison. Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur. Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles. Vos responsabilités principales : Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH. Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière. Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux. Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH. Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés. Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture. Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif. Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents. Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs. Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur. Profil : Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines . Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration . Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire. Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales . Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH. Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers. Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH. Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles. Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout. Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive. Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ? Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain , au cœur de la vie de la Maison. L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours. Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation. Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur . Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève. La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage. Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison. Nos offres d’emploi s’adressent autant aux femmes qu’aux hommes. title: Content & Social Growth Manager:in (80–100 %)
description: Was bluu bewegt Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen. Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack. Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa? Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst. Deine Verantwortung Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt. Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um. Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser. Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen. E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir. Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle. Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

  • Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

  • Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

  • Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

  • Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

  • Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

  • Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

  • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

  • Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

  • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

  • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

  • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

  • Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

  • Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

  • The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

  • Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

  • Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

  • Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

  • Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

  • A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

  • Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

  • Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

  • Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

  • Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

  • Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

  • Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

  • Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

  • Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Du koordinierst und briefst interne Aktivierungsabteilungen.</li> <li><strong>Markt- &amp; Partnermanagement:</strong> Verantwortung für das Setup und Handling externer Dienstleistungen und Marktteilnehmender, Beobachtung des Wettbewerbs sowie Identifikation von Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und Unterstützung interner Projekte.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Mediaerfahrung:</strong> Berufserfahrung in der Mediaberatung und/oder Mediaplanung, idealerweise in einer Mediaagentur.</li> <li><strong>Strategisches Media-Know-how:</strong> Verständnis für Marken-, Media- und Kommunikationsstrategien sowie Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Kampagnen über verschiedene Medienkanäle.</li> <li><strong>Kundenberatung &amp; Kommunikation:</strong> Souveränes, kommunikatives Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zielgruppengerecht und verständlich zu vermitteln.</li> <li><strong>Organisation &amp; Qualität:</strong> Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und qualitative Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, mehrere Projekte und Aufgaben zu koordinieren.</li> <li><strong>Verantwortung &amp; Teamgeist:</strong> Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit sowie daran, Junior-Kolleg:innen zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> <li><strong>Sprachkenntnisse:</strong> Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du: <strong>#client-partner #media-strategist #team-player</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Du betreust unser internes Netzwerk, überwachst es aktiv und schützt unsere Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit geeigneten Tools und Firewalls. Du überwachst den operativen Betrieb proaktiv mit modernen Monitoring-Tools und behebst Störungen frühzeitig. Du verwaltest selbstständig die Benutzerberechtigungen im Active Directory und in Microsoft 365 und betreust gemeinsam mit unserem Partner unsere 3CX-Telefonielösung. Software & Innovation Du unterstützt das Team bei der Entwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung unserer internen Applikationen und Schnittstellen. Du nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen auf und setzt sie in pragmatische technische Lösungen um. Du testest moderne KI-Tools und integrierst sie, um interne Prozesse einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten. Support & Teamwork Du arbeitest im First- und Second-Level-Support mit und beantwortest die Fragen unserer Mitarbeitenden kompetent und hilfsbereit. Qualifikation Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ mit Schwerpunkt Systemtechnik oder Applikationsentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung. Fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb von Windows Server- und Client-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in Proxmox VE (PVE) sind ein Plus. Ein gutes Grundverständnis für Netzwerke und Firewalls sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein. Erste Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# im .NET-Umfeld und JavaScript sowie Freude daran, dieses Wissen zu vertiefen. Routine mit PowerShell oder anderen Skriptsprachen, um Aufgaben und administrative Prozesse zu automatisieren. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Du packst Aufgaben proaktiv an. Grosses Interesse an neuen Technologien und Lust, das Potenzial von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag auszuloten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Fachliteratur und Dokumentationen. Eine pragmatische Kultur, in der neugierige Ideen willkommen sind und KI-Tools aktiv eingesetzt werden. 5 Wochen Ferien. Jedes dritte Jahr eine zusätzliche Ferienwoche oder deren Auszahlung. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Creative Fabrica</strong></p> <p>Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.</p></div><h3><strong>About the team: idea.ai</strong></h3> <p>idea.ai is our bet on what creative software looks like when AI is the default, not a feature.</p> <p>We built a single platform where anyone can generate and edit images, video, audio, 3D models, and vector graphics using state-of-the-art generative AI. Our tools serve hundreds of thousands of creators every day, from hobbyist crafters to professional designers and everything in between, all in one place.</p> <p>We move fast, integrate frontier models into production-ready workflows, and build the infrastructure that gives creators every tool they need to turn any idea into professional-grade media, at scale.</p> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer (Go), you will be the architect of our multimodal generation pipeline. You won't just be building APIs; you’ll be designing the high-concurrency systems that orchestrate "heavy" AI workloads across any media domains. Your goal is to make complex, multi step AI generation feel instantaneous and reliable for a global audience of creators.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Orchestrate Multimodal Workflows:</strong> Design and scale Go-based microservices that manage the lifecycle of AI generations.</li> <li><strong>Performance Engineering:</strong> Optimize our ConnectRPC services and async processing pipelines (Kafka + SQS) to handle long-running, resource-intensive inference tasks without compromising platform stability.</li> <li><strong>Build the Creative Engine:</strong> Develop the backend logic for advanced features like multimodal orchestration.</li> <li><strong>Data &amp; Infrastructure:</strong> Work with AWS to manage massive data throughput and integrate with high-performance storage and compute clusters.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with AI Researchers:</strong> Bridge the gap between raw model outputs and a polished "One Person Studio" user experience.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Go Engineering:</strong> Extensive experience building and scaling Go services in high-traffic, high-volume SaaS environments.</li> <li><strong>Distributed Systems Mastery:</strong> Proven ability to design microservices that utilize asynchronous processing (Kafka &amp; SQS) and low-latency communication (gRPC/ConnectRPC/GraphQL).</li> <li><strong>Cloud Architecture:</strong> Deep knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) and experience managing complex compute environments.</li> <li><strong>Product Rigor:</strong> A background in building professional-grade creative tools or media-heavy applications.</li> <li><strong>Software Best Practices:</strong> A quality-first mindset regarding code reviews, testing strategies, and observability.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Media Processing Experience:</strong> Familiarity with handling varied media types (video transcoding, audio synthesis, vector manipulation).</li> <li><strong>AI Infrastructure:</strong> Experience with model serving at scale or managing GPU-accelerated workloads.</li> <li><strong>Entrepreneurial Mindset:</strong> Experience in a fast-paced environment where you help define the product vision and iterate quickly.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="job-blocks"> <div id="block-13" class="text block"> <div class="body" data-columns="1"> <h3 class="article"><strong>Is this you?</strong></h3> </div> </div> </div> <div class="job-blocks"> <div id="block-15" class="vacancy-text block"> <div class="body" data-columns="1"> <div class="article" data-medium-editor-element=""> <p>Get in touch! title: IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior)
description: Make technology work for everyone At Sunweb Group, technology plays a key role in delivering unforgettable holiday experiences to more than 1.3 million customers every year. Behind the scenes, our colleagues rely on secure, reliable, and user-friendly IT solutions to do their best work.  As an IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior), you are the first point of contact for employees across our international organization. From resolving technical issues and supporting new joiners to improving processes and maintaining our digital workplace, you make sure colleagues can work efficiently and without disruption.   You'll join our IT team in Rotterdam and collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and development specialists to provide an excellent employee experience. Location: Rotterdam Start Date: ASAP Availability: Full-time Your impact In this role, you'll support colleagues across our international organisation, different hub offices and business functions. You'll combine hands-on IT support with ownership and continuous improvement, acting as a trusted point of contact for both colleagues and stakeholders. Depending on your experience, you'll also take the lead in specific areas of expertise, support less experienced colleagues and contribute to improving and automating our IT processes. Responsibilities Resolve first- and second-line IT incidents and service requests through Jira, phone, email and walk-ins. Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, Microsoft 365 and workplace-related issues. Support onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, permissions, access and device setup. Make sure new colleagues have the right tools and systems available from day one. Manage and maintain user accounts, devices and workplace applications. Act as an escalation point for more complex incidents and service requests. Work closely with Infrastructure, Security and Development teams to resolve technical issues. Contribute to ITIL-based service management processes and maintain clear knowledge documentation. Identify recurring issues and turn them into opportunities for process improvements and automation. Take ownership of specific areas of expertise, such as Microsoft 365 or IT service management. Share knowledge, coach colleagues and contribute to the development of the wider IT support team. Proactively engage with stakeholders to understand their needs and continuously improve the employee IT experience. What you'll bring   At least 4 years of experience in IT support, service desk, workplace support or a similar role. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure and modern workplace environments. Experience supporting Windows 11, macOS and mobile devices such as iPhones and iPads. Experience with service management tools, preferably Jira Service Management. A good understanding of ITIL principles and service desk best practices. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to prioritise effectively. The confidence to work independently, take ownership and act as an escalation point for colleagues. Experience supporting, coaching or mentoring less experienced team members. The ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues. A proactive, service-minded approach and a strong sense of ownership. Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus, but not required. Microsoft, Azure and/or Workplace Management certifications are a strong advantage. You are based in the Netherlands and able to work regularly from our Rotterdam office. About Sunweb Group Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.    Why join our journey? Monthly gross salary between €3,700 and €4300 plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance) . Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. What success looks like in your first 3–6 months The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. What we're looking for You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse Advanced SQL as your daily working language Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. Data Engineer

Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them.

Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet.

You will build the foundation that fixes this.

What you'll do

  • Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it.

  • Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production.

  • Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team.

  • Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent.

  • Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io.

  • Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today.

  • Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards.

What success looks like in your first 3–6 months

  • The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring.

  • You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work

  • Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do.

  • Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them.


What we're looking for

You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in:

  • Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse

  • Advanced SQL as your daily working language

  • Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP

  • Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience.

  • ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management

  • Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start

  • Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration

  • Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment

Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required.

This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. You'll report to the Head of Operations and partner closely with the Platform team on the company's data architecture.

raw.title: Frontend Engineer
raw.description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

What we offer

  • A laptop on Mac, Windows, or Linux

  • 32 or 40 hours workweek

  • Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office

  • 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract

  • Pension plan

  • NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed.

  • Training budget for personal development

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.

title: Account Executive - NL Region
description: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee. Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar. Wie ben jij? Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen. Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre. Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast 25 vakantiedagen, een flexibele regeling voor thuis en op kantoor werken, een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding). De werksfeer? Ontspannen, met gratis lunch, bootcamp op donderdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en kwartaal-BBQ's. Hoe werken we samen? De eerste 3 maanden verwachten we een hogere aanwezigheid op kantoor in Zoetermeer. Logisch: je wilt het team, het product en de klant snel doorgronden, en dat gaat nu eenmaal sneller als je er bent. Na je onboarding werken we meer hybride. Woon je op maximaal anderhalf uur reisafstand? Dan verwachten we je minimaal één keer per week op kantoor, op dinsdag of donderdag. In de praktijk gaan we hier flexibel mee om zodra het vertrouwen er is. Woon je dichterbij of heb je geen probleem met wat meer reistijd? Elke dag op kantoor is natuurlijk ook gewoon mogelijk. Daarnaast is er de hub in Amsterdam waar je terecht kunt. Waarom Shiftbase? Je verkoopt geen vaag platform dat niemand begrijpt. Shiftbase is marktleider in Nederland en groeit hard in Duitsland. Een product dat 10.000+ bedrijven dagelijks gebruiken omdat het hun werk simpelweg makkelijker maakt. Dat merk je in elk salesgesprek: klanten snappen de waarde, de use case is herkenbaar en de feedback is positief. Tegelijkertijd zijn we geen logge olietanker. Met 85+ collega's ben je geen nummer, want wat jij doet heeft directe impact op de koers van het bedrijf. Maar we zijn wél groot en stabiel genoeg om je een serieuze carrière te bieden. Geen start-up-roulette, maar een bewezen business met internationale groeiambities waar jij onderdeel van wordt. Interesse? Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Jurrien Strobel via Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Product Owner
description: About Us Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we’ve been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy — Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts — and our motto: One team. One dream. The Role We’re looking for an AI Product Owner to lead the way in turning ideas into impactful AI solutions. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between business needs, user experience, and technical execution. From ideation to delivery, you’ll own the AI product roadmap, making sure every product we launch creates measurable value, drives innovation, and is grounded in real-world usability. You’ll work hand in hand with engineers, data scientists, marketers, and commercial teams to identify opportunities, prioritize features, and bring innovative AI products to life. Key Responsibilities Define and own the AI product vision and roadmap — set priorities, milestones, and adapt as business goals and market needs evolve. Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams. Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to deliver AI-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, engagement, and outcomes. Stay ahead of AI and machine learning trends to ensure Creative Clicks is always leading innovation. Champion AI adoption across the company, driving awareness and practical application. Define and track KPIs to measure product success and business impact. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and communication across teams. Als Lead Software Engineer PLC & Industrial Automation neem jij de technische leiding over de softwareontwikkeling binnen complexe hightech machinebouw. Je vertaalt functionele eisen en klantwensen naar een robuuste besturingsoplossing en bewaakt de technische keuzes van ontwerp en architectuur tot commissioning en ingebruikname.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent technisch verantwoordelijk voor de software binnen multidisciplinaire machinebouwprojecten. Je vertaalt klantwensen en systeemeisen naar een softwarearchitectuur en bepaalt hoe de besturing wordt opgebouwd:

  • Ontwerpen van softwarearchitectuur voor complexe machines

  • Ontwikkelen van PLC-software en oplossingen voor motion en robotica

  • Vertalen van requirements naar technische oplossingen

  • Inhoudelijk aansturen en begeleiden van software engineers

  • Afstemmen met system, mechanical en electrical engineering

  • Bewaken van technische keuzes, kwaliteit en voortgang

  • Testen, debuggen en commissionen van machines

  • Technische afstemming met klanten tijdens het project

Hoe je impact maakt

Jouw keuzes bepalen hoe een machine wordt aangestuurd en hoe betrouwbaar deze uiteindelijk presteert. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de PLC-code en overziet de samenhang tussen software, motion, robotica, hardware en mechanica.
Je bent technisch aanspreekpunt voor engineers en klanten, neemt andere software engineers mee in technische keuzes en zorgt dat oplossingen niet alleen werken, maar ook robuust, onderhoudbaar en herbruikbaar zijn. Daarmee heb je direct invloed op zowel de machine als de manier waarop software binnen toekomstige projecten wordt ontwikkeld.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description: Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Role and Responsibilities AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools. Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business. This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work.   What You'll Own Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns. Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle. Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt. Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes. Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge. Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust. A Typical Week This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support. Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production. Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition. Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work. Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team. Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work. What Success Looks Like Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem. Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance. Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established. Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap. We offer A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions. Competitive, benchmarked compensation. Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals. Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding. 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR. The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice. A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year. A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform. A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning. All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need. A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym. Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide . Apply for the Job Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027. P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist. Who you are You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you. You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery. You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards. You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase. You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You understand how bookings, billings, recognized revenue, cash, ARR, and NRR differ without treating financial reporting as the whole analytical problem. You have worked in a B2B SaaS, subscription, fintech, or marketplace business and have modeled several stages of the funnel spanning marketing or growth, sales, customer success and retention, and product usage—rather than specializing in only one function. You explain complex logic in plain language, push back constructively on senior stakeholders, and build trust without becoming defensive—even when you discover that your own number or assumption needs to change. You take pride in driving the analytical roadmap and architectural vision, leading technical work through architecture and code review, and mentoring experienced colleagues without relying on formal authority. You want the majority of your role to remain hands-on. You balance pragmatic execution with rigorous analysis, adapting precision levels to fit business needs and operational constraints. You are used to leveraging a broad range of AI tools to boost your productivity and know how to configure them to produce output that lives up to our quality standards and best practices Nice to Have Earlier experience in RevOps, Growth, FP&A, product analytics, or commercial analytics, ideally combined with experience in a fast-growing scale-up. Experience with HubSpot, marketing automation and attribution data, subscription or billing data, LMS or product-usage event data, Personio, or building semantic layers for AI-enabled and conversational analytics.
